$description: Rekta Design's named accents: values for the accent slot (accent, on-accent) that a product, or its user, picks by name instead of finding two colours per theme by hand. Each holds the accent rules in every theme: 3:1 on bg and surface, on-accent 4.5:1 on it (7:1 in light-contrast and dark-contrast), apart from status (docs/colour.md). Ink, the default, is one of them. Not tokens: a product's choice of values for two tokens. build.mjs ships them as `accents` in rekta.tokens.json and as :root[data-accent="NAME"] in rekta.tokens.css; --check holds every value to the rules; rekta-core has them as rk_app_set_accent_named().

ink.$description: The default: the theme's text colour, with the ground on it. Picked by name, it wins over a product's own accent.

teal.$description: Between success and info. Dark text on it in light and dark; under more contrast a deep teal with white in light.

steel.$description: A blue grey, so low in chroma that it reads as grey beside info.

violet.$description: The furthest from every status, under colour blindness too.

pink.$description: Between violet and error; dark text on it in light and dark.

magenta.$description: The nearest to error the rules allow: 27° of hue and 0.05 under deuteranopia apart.
